reason.message: The edge node reports state AVAILABLE with qwen3.6-27b loaded, so it can answer with no load step. prefer-warm-local sets warm_preference: strict, which means any warm candidate beats any cold one regardless of prefer_order - so the edge wins even though kserve-a5000 is listed first.
